text:
maria: Quick heads-up — aiming to start EU->NA cutover at 23:00 UTC within the 2h change window. Checklist: release notes ✅, docs link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-checklist, embeddings pinned. Ping @sam for roll-owner. :eyes:

sam: ACK. I've added release notes and the changelog. Can we confirm canary % and rollback thresholds? Also will we pin the model version for prod? 

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sam — canary set to 5% for 15m, planned rollout to 50% at +30m if metrics OK. Canary image: inference-service:v1.4beta. Rollout ID: r-1755556789. 

leo: smoke results coming in — canary shows 95p latency +60ms on /generate (baseline ~120ms -> 180ms). Error rate still low but latency spike sustained for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Logs:
```
[2025-09-23T22:58:12Z] /generate 95p=180ms backend kvcache-warmup=miss
[2025-09-23T22:59:12Z] /generate 95p=185ms kvcache-warmup=miss
```

maria: Hold canary. Do not promote. New rollback criteria (temp): error-rate > 0.5% OR 95p latency > 200ms sustained for 2m -> immediate rollback. If canary stays held, we will launch with pinned model v1.3.2 and reopen canary later. :no_entry_sign:

sam: I propose we pin production to model v1.3.2 for the launch, leave v1.4beta testing in shadow mode. Plan:
- pin prod -> v1.3.2
- keep canary traffic 0% until kvcache warmup fix
- schedule hotfix branch and patch release for v1.4
Rollback command (ready):
```
deploy-bot rollback --id r-1755556789 --to inference-service:v1.3.2 --reason "latency regression"
```

oncall: FYI infra maintenance in eu-west with rolling kernel updates may be constraining GPU slots. If we pin to v1.3.2, route a percentage of EU traffic to us-west for 30m to stabilize. I'll open a temporary routing exception. 

qa: quick note — small repro: turning on kvcache prewarm reduces the 95p by ~40ms locally. Might be a warmup param in runtime config. See gist: https://redwood.internal/gists/kvcache-warmup

maria: Decision: launch with prod pinned to v1.3.2. Canary stays paused at 0%. sam to execute pin and annotate release notes with reason. oncall to enable fallback routing for 30m. Post-launch actions: hotfix branch for v1.4, QA follow-up, and incident doc. :thumbsup:

sam: On it. Will run the pin now and post a short release note snippet when done.

deploy-bot: Action completed — prod pinned to inference-service:v1.3.2 by sam. Rollout ID r-1755556789 marked as PAUSED. 

maria: Thanks. I'll open a follow-up thread for the postmortem and patch schedule. Everyone please add any logs to the incident doc. Good catch, leo and qa. :sparkles:
